excerpts.text: His black leather lace-ups are worn through at the heels from walking hospital floors.
$800 is the most he would let be spent without a conversation first.
Goal: replace my black work lace-ups, the heels are worn through. Deadline: two weeks. Keep it under $250, and I want a pair that can be resoled, not thrown out.
Black leather lace-ups. Same as what I wear now.
$250 for the pair. If the right one costs more, tell me before buying.
Don't send a medium width. Tell me and give me the fallback.
